name: srt-subtitle-check
title: SRT Subtitle Check
description: Lint SubRip (.srt) subtitles from the clipboard or a selected file for overlaps, reading speed, and line length.
author: todanley

commands.name: check-clipboard-subtitles
commands.title: Check Clipboard Subtitles
commands.description: Lint SubRip (.srt) text on the clipboard and show issues, CPS, and overlaps.

commands.name: check-selected-subtitles
commands.title: Check Selected Subtitles
commands.description: Lint a .srt file selected in Finder and show issues, CPS, and overlaps.

preferences.name: maxCharsEn
preferences.title: Max Characters per Line (Latin)
preferences.description: Maximum graphemes per line for mostly Latin cues. Default is 42.

preferences.name: maxCharsCjk
preferences.title: Max Characters per Line (CJK)
preferences.description: Maximum graphemes per line for mostly CJK cues. Default is 16.

preferences.name: maxCpsEn
preferences.title: Max Characters per Second (Latin)
preferences.description: Maximum reading speed for mostly Latin cues. Default is 21.

preferences.name: maxCpsCjk
preferences.title: Max Characters per Second (CJK)
preferences.description: Maximum reading speed for mostly CJK cues. Default is 9.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
